title: Joint Contrastive-Adversarial Representation Learning for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) requires a representation that captures transferable structure from both the labeled source domain and the unlabeled target domain. We introduce Joint Contrastive-Adversarial Representation Learning (JCAR), a two-stage framework that learns a common representation from the union of unlabeled source and target samples by combining contrastive learning with adversarial domain alignment, and then freezes the representation to fit a source-supervised predictor. We establish a non-asymptotic excess-risk bound for this procedure that couples representation and domain-discriminator estimation while separating downstream prediction, with explicit neural-network approximation errors. Under the stated assumptions and common H\"older smoothness $\beta\geq1$, the bound identifies a sufficiently large unlabeled-sample regime in which the downstream rate is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(m^{-\beta/(2\beta+d)})$

translated_title: 面向无监督域自适应的联合对比-对抗表示学习
translated_abstract: 有效的无监督域自适应（UDA）需要一个能够同时从有标签源域和无标签目标域中捕获可迁移结构的表示。我们提出了联合对比-对抗表示学习（JCAR），这是一个两阶段框架：第一阶段通过将对比学习与对抗域对齐相结合，从无标签源域和目标域样本的并集中学习一个共同表示；第二阶段冻结该表示，并拟合一个由源域监督的预测器。我们为该过程建立了非渐近超额风险界，该风险界将表示学习和域判别器的估计耦合在一起，同时将下游预测分离出来，并包含显式的神经网络逼近误差。在所述假设及常见的Hölder光滑性β≥1条件下，该界指出了一个无标签样本量足够大的情形，此时下游预测的收敛速率为 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(m^{-\beta/(2\beta+d)})$。
tldr: 提出JCAR两阶段框架，将对比学习与对抗域对齐相结合以学习源域和目标域的共同表示，并建立了非渐近超额风险界，证明当无标签样本足够多时，下游预测可达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(m^{-\beta/(2\beta+d)})$ 的收敛速率。
